description: Java class 'SurveyWrapper' for rendering and managing survey forms, including retrieving questions, responses, and generating survey result summaries.

classes.name: SurveyWrapper
classes.description: Java class for wrapping survey functionalities including rendering, responses management, and result analysis.

methods.name: setDelegator
methods.description: Sets the delegator instance used for database operations.

methods.name: setPartyId
methods.description: Sets the party ID associated with the survey.

methods.name: setSurveyId
methods.description: Sets the survey ID.

methods.name: SurveyWrapper
methods.description: Constructors for initializing the SurveyWrapper with various parameters.

methods.name: checkParameters
methods.description: Ensures that essential parameters (delegator and surveyId) are set.

methods.name: setPassThru
methods.description: Sets hidden form field values to pass through.

methods.name: setDefaultValues
methods.description: Sets default answers or values for survey questions.

methods.name: addToTemplateContext
methods.description: Adds an object to the FreeMarker template context.

methods.name: removeFromTemplateContext
methods.description: Removes an object from the FreeMarker template context.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the survey template from a file path into a Writer.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the survey using a URL template and writes output.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Loads a FreeMarker template from a URL.

methods.name: setEdit
methods.description: Sets whether the survey is editable.

methods.name: getSurvey
methods.description: Retrieves the GenericValue object representing the survey.

methods.name: getSurveyName
methods.description: Returns the name of the survey.

methods.name: canUpdate
methods.description: Determines if the survey can be updated based on permission and survey settings.

methods.name: canRespond
methods.description: Checks if the user can respond to the survey.

methods.name: getSurveyQuestionAndAppls
methods.description: Retrieves the list of survey questions and applications.

methods.name: getThisResponseId
methods.description: Gets the most current response ID for the user/party's survey.

methods.name: setThisResponseId
methods.description: Sets the response ID explicitly.

methods.name: getNumberResponses
methods.description: Returns the total number of responses for the survey.

methods.name: getSurveyResponses
methods.description: Retrieves responses for a specific question.

methods.name: getResponseAnswers
methods.description: Gets answers for a survey response, including passing form data.

methods.name: getQuestionResponses
methods.description: Retrieves responses for a question with pagination.

methods.name: getResults
methods.description: Calculates and returns statistical results for questions.

methods.name: getResultInfo
methods.description: Provides detailed analysis for a survey question.

methods.name: getBooleanResult
methods.description: Calculates boolean (Yes/No) responses for a question.

methods.name: getNumberResult
methods.description: Calculates numerical responses with different number types.

methods.name: getTextResult
methods.description: Counts text responses for a question.

methods.name: getOptionResult
methods.description: Calculates responses by option for multiple choice questions.

methods.name: makeEliCondition
methods.description: Creates an entity condition for query filtering based on a survey question.

methods.name: getEli
methods.description: Creates an entity list iterator for survey response answers.

methods.description: Custom exception class for errors in SurveyWrapper.
